sections.heading: 1. Thumb break routine
lines: ① Every 30–45 min, put the controller down.
② Open your hand wide, then a soft fist, 10 times.
③ Slow thumb circles, 5 each way.
④ Lighter grip — buttons need only a light press.

sections.heading: 2. Stop if…
lines: The thumb side of your wrist swells, or
pain gets worse — stop and get advice.

caption:
Momo games for hours on weekends, and afterwards the thumb side of her wrist aches.

During a game, your thumb repeats small, fast movements with barely a break. Gripping the controller tightly for long sessions can leave the thumb tendons feeling cranky.

Hybi's 1-minute break: every 30-45 minutes put the controller down, open your hand wide then make a soft fist 10 times, and do 5 slow thumb circles each way. A lighter grip helps too.

Swelling, clicking or catching, or pain lasting more than two weeks is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🎮
